card.title: Start the Hard Part
card.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You tell the choir the tour's cancelled. I'll hand out the refund forms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The forms will need my full attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say 'funding' first. I'll join after the disappointed silence.

mechanism: A delegates the emotionally hard cancellation announcement while reserving practical paperwork and joining only after disappointment.
confusable: Unlike ordinary task division, A must make B begin the emotional exposure before A participates.
comparison: D101-a delays joining until after silence; D101-b accepts speakerphone presence but makes B say selling first.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
